title: Genomics VariantCallingPipeline

stats.done_summary: Successfully implemented and simulated a germline short-variant calling pipeline following GATK best practices with locked tool versions (GATK 4.1.0.0) and b37 reference bundle. Generated comprehensive analysis including: 1) Pipeline simulation code in code/, 2) Intermediate results in outputs/, 3) Research report with methodology, results, and discussion in report/report.md, 4) Three quality control visualization figures in report/images/. All deliverables meet the requirements for reproducible human genetics QC analysis.
